description: Paradise Valley Motorized Trail System is for ATV, UTV and snowmobile enjoyment. This trail system consists of over 250 kms and includes multiple warming shelters. This recreation feature is managed in partnership with Paradise Valley Snowmobile Association (www.facebook.com/pvsadawsoncreek). Please note that the trails are not groomed. The trailhead is located at km 3 on the Radar Lake / Bear Mountain Wind Park Road.
directions: From Dawson Creek, take Hwy 2 to the southern edge of Dawson Creek. Head west on the Dangerous Goods Route, drive 3.2 km. Turn left (west) onto the Adam's Road and drive 1.7 km. Turn left (south) on to the 223 Road drive 1.6 km. Continue straight onto the Radar Lake / Bear Mountain Wind Park Road, travel to km 3. Please take note that the Radar Lake / Bear Mountain Wind Park Road is an active industrial road and may have heavy traffic.
title: Paradise Valley
